title: Joint-Embedding Prediction of Masked Point Tubes for Self-Supervised Learning on 4D Point Cloud Videos
abstract: arXiv:2608.24093v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-supervised representation learning for 4D point cloud videos is challenging because annotations are costly and reconstruction-based pretraining can overemphasize low-level geometric details. We propose a JEPA-style framework that learns from unlabeled spatiotemporal point clouds through latent point-tube prediction. Instead of reconstructing raw coordinates, the model masks spatiotemporal regions and predicts their target representations from visible context representations in feature space. To stabilize latent prediction, we incorporate Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization, which encourages non-collapsed embeddings without relying on explicit reconstruction targets. This formulation aims to capture both spatial structure and temporal dynamics while keeping the pretraining objective aligned with downstream semantic recognition. translated_title: 联合嵌入预测掩蔽点管用于4D点云视频的自监督学习
translated_abstract: 4D点云视频的自监督表示学习具有挑战性，因为标注成本高昂，且基于重建的预训练可能过度强调低级几何细节。我们提出了一种JEPA风格的框架，通过潜在点管预测从未标记的时空点云中学习。该模型不重建原始坐标，而是掩蔽时空区域，并在特征空间中从可见上下文表示预测其目标表示。为了稳定潜在预测，我们引入了草图各向同性高斯正则化，该正则化鼓励非塌缩嵌入，而无需依赖显式重建目标。这一设计旨在捕捉空间结构和时间动态，同时保持预训练目标与下游语义识别的一致性。在动作和手势识别基准上的实验表明，学习到的表示显著提升了性能。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于JEPA风格的4D点云视频自监督学习框架，通过潜在点管预测和草图各向同性高斯正则化，无需重建原始坐标即可捕捉时空结构，提升下游识别性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a JEPA-style self-supervised framework for 4D point cloud videos that predicts latent point tubes with sketched isotropic Gaussian regularization, avoiding raw reconstruction to capture spatiotemporal semantics and improve downstream recognition.
